wf142_strengthen.title: Per-pocket high_affinity lift on Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort at ex=32, n_poses=5
wf142_strengthen.verdict: MEASURED_PARTIAL_LIFT — Wf-142 P1 ex=32 + n_poses=5 on 3ny8 closure-bounded cohort: rate 4/18=0.222 -> 4/14=0.286 (delta +0.064). kcal_min -7.466 -> -7.462 (essentially unchanged). Same 4 SMILES beat the JRZ reference (-7.14) at both ex settings - ex lift does NOT break new ground on 3ny8 (cohort ceiling, not Vina search). FAILS 0.30 uniform floor by 0.014. Honest reporting: lift is real but small; partial improvement on a single pocket.
